stillProvisioning: This Zoom meeting is still being set up. Try again in a moment, or use "Provision now" on the session page.
loadFailed: Could not load the Zoom meeting. Check your connection and try again.
notReadyToHost: This Zoom meeting is not ready to host yet — it may still be getting set up on Zoom. Refresh in a moment, or re-check the Zoom account if it persists.
missingZak: Cannot start this meeting as host: Zoom did not issue a host start-token (ZAK). Reconnect Zoom in Settings → Live Session — remove the app in your Zoom account first so the consent screen reappears, then approve the ZAK scope (user_zak:read / user:read:zak).
joinFailed: Could not start the Zoom meeting ({{code}}).
initFailed: Could not initialise the Zoom meeting ({{code}}).
startFailed: Failed to start the Zoom meeting.
refreshOrRetry: Please refresh the page or try again.
